[[File:Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.jpg|right|alt=Red Ajah sister|thumb]]The table below lists all known named members of the [[Red Ajah]] together with information about each, mostly from [[The Wheel of Time Companion]]. 

All the Red sisters were Loyalists during the [[White Tower Schism]]. They, at least, kept any criticisms of [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] in private and there were no known Red sisters in the Rebel or unaligned groups. The Amyrlins [[Bonwhin Meraighdin]] and [[Tetsuan]] do not appear in this table.
